retail_vs_institutional_positioning.retail_positioning_summary: Retail equity investors across Reddit (r/stocks, r/wallstreetbets, r/options) and X FinTwit regard Amazon as a premier compounder and foundational mega-cap AI play. Sentiment is +84% bullish heading into the Oct 29 print, driven by excitement over accelerating AWS cloud demand, massive advertising growth on Prime Video, and AI automation across fulfillment centers. Options retail flow is heavily skewed towards upside call buying, with heavy volume in the weekly $260 and $275 strike calls. Retail traders view the recent consolidation around $249.43 as an attractive launchpad for a breakout toward all-time highs.
retail_vs_institutional_positioning.institutional_positioning_summary: Institutional sell-side coverage is near-unanimously bullish: 58 analysts covering AMZN maintain a Strong Buy consensus (1.33 mean rating) with an average price target of $332.24 (+33.20% upside) and Street-high targets reaching $405.00. Institutional hedge funds and large asset managers maintain overweight positioning, citing Amazon's unique dual-engine flywheel: high-margin AWS enterprise cloud acceleration and rapid retail media advertising growth offsetting holiday retail cyclicality. With the Put/Call Open Interest ratio at an ultra-bullish 0.34x, institutional positioning is aggressively levered to upside breakout scenarios, viewing the ±7.56% ($18.85) weekly straddle as fairly priced for a high-conviction beat-and-raise print.
